nodes.name: Check Inbox (Every 5 Min)
nodes.notes: Polls the reply-to inbox every 5 minutes for new emails. REQUIRES: IMAP credentials for the REPLY_TO_EMAIL mailbox (hello@lnlautomations.com). Create IMAP credentials in n8n: Settings > Credentials > IMAP with your mail server details.

nodes.name: Extract Sender & Match Lead
nodes.notes: Extracts sender email, subject, and body. Flags system/bounce emails for filtering.

nodes.name: Filter System Emails
nodes.notes: Drops bounce notifications, noreply senders, and internal LNL emails

nodes.name: Lookup Lead in Pipeline
nodes.notes: Fetches all leads from Lead Pipeline to match sender email against Email column

nodes.name: Match Sender to Lead
nodes.notes: Cross-references sender email against Lead Pipeline Email column. Returns matched lead data or flags as unmatched.

nodes.name: IF Lead Matched
nodes.notes: Routes matched leads to status update + forward path. Unmatched emails get forwarded anyway (could be a new prospect).

nodes.name: Update Lead Status → REPLIED
nodes.notes: Updates lead status to REPLIED. Matches on Email column. This status is checked by the Cold Outreach Agent Logic Gate to halt future touches.

nodes.name: Format Forward Email (Matched)
nodes.notes: Formats a rich forwarded email with lead context card so you can reply with full context

nodes.name: Forward to Owner
nodes.notes: Forwards the lead's reply to you with reply-to set to the lead's email so you can respond directly from your inbox

nodes.name: Format Forward Email (Unmatched)
nodes.notes: Formats forward for emails from senders not found in the pipeline — still forwarded for visibility

nodes.name: Forward Unmatched to Owner
nodes.notes: Forwards unmatched inbound email. Reply-to set to sender so you can respond directly.

nodes.name: Log Reply Event

value.Action: ={{ $json.matched ? 'Lead Reply Detected — Status → REPLIED' : 'Inbound Email — No Pipeline Match' }}

nodes.notes: Logs every reply detection event (matched and unmatched) to the Sheet Hygiene Log for auditability
